propositions: Integration fixture test_reconcile_roundtrip._load_module unconditionally replaces sys.modules[canonical_adf_key] with a new module object, breaking the canonical module identity invariant
AdfCodec retains a reference to the prior ADF module object while a later-loaded distinct object gets installed in sys.modules, causing codec to call one module while tests monkeypatch another
Test cloud_functions_degrade_without_marklas fails only when serial full-suite ordering causes the integration round-trip fixture to execute before it, but passes in isolation
Runtime identity experiments proved codec output follows the retained module object exclusively, rejecting hidden cache/state as the failure mechanism
_load_module now caches and returns existing modules when both canonical name and __file__ match, preserving different-source replacement behavior while fixing canonical identity leaks
